literal: أحضر لحم الخنزير المقدد إلى المنزل بدون رسوم
adaptation: رزقك يوصلك كامل… بدون أي رسوم
back_translation: Your livelihood reaches you in full… with zero fees
notes: Bacon is pork and religiously prohibited in Saudi Arabia, so it would offend audiences and damage a bank's credibility; I swapped the idiom for the culturally resonant concept of 'rizq' (livelihood) while keeping the earn-and-keep-it-all message.
